_doc: Kit pieces modelled in Blender instead of kiln (S36; owner 2026-11-03: anything with curves or organic shapes goes to Blender, rigid and square pieces stay in kiln). After kiln build, godot/tools/blender/build_models.py runs each script on every loom of the piece: the kiln GLB gives the materials and the height, the script's mesh replaces it in out/models/. Then bake_kits.py (art/ao.json).
